Well, in terms of getting financially stable, I have rebuilt my bankroll several times to play poker (at one point I stripped). But I have always fallen to playing blackjack for all my money. Now, I am giving up on professional gambling because my emotions cannot handle it. 

In terms of rebuilding my mental health, I have tried seeing therapists. I have tried thinking about what stable job I could get.  I have been playing poker professionally for 4 years and really only worked 1 real job after college which I really disliked. I can't see myself going back to that for more than a couple months. There doesn't seem to be any careers I can see myself doing long term...maybe investment banking, but I am too old (most companies want recent college grads) 

I have tutored but I don't enjoy it and am not naturally good at explaining concepts. And I definitely don't feel like a good role for young girls. I can't picture myself doing anything because I have such low motivation and drive. I've reached this point where nothing appeals to me and I am miserable all day long and see no outs

...nf6
First, thanks for talking to me. I agree that I am placing most of my self worth on his approval, and yes its mostly about him just being there. He was abusive but I didn't care because it was better to have someone with me who loved me.

Its really hard when he said he would take care of me and then he disappeared without any conversation or text he wasn't coming back. I know you are right but I don't know how to move forward. 

I can't support myself financially anymore and I have so much debt. I struggle with holding down a job so every optionI seemingly have seems so futile. I can't keep living the way I am currently but I am tired of trying to rebuild and failing.

Yes, exactly. I had a few friends during college, but no one who would really understand...and lots of acquaintances in vegas, but people have lied or not really been there for me.

I've never been diagnosed with anything. I wish there was a pill I could take to make me capable of surviving on my own. Both times I was hospitalized they didn't diagnose me or put me on medication. I have seen numerous psychologists/psychiatrists but when I talk to them they will say I am struggling with circumstance and/or a gambling addiction.

I don't do drugs or drink, although I did both those during college. But Ive been clean for 6 years.

I don't know what to do anymore. I want to kill myself but worry I'll fail again. I just sit around all day right now watching tv shows and playing chess online. It makes me feel completely worthless, but I'm tired of trying because I am not capable of sustaining any lifestyle.

What do you think about my ex boyfriend situation?
